assembly: Provide only common plus assigned role text and exact case/prior artifact bindings; D roles use D_common instead. Administrative treatment hypotheses/arm catalog stay outside control contexts.
common: Read only assigned synthetic case and exact prior artifacts; no archives, siblings, history, web or agents. Preserve outcome/constraints; invent no observations/resources. Save first JSON at assigned path, no retries/overwrite; soft420 words. Echo case_id,job_id,role. Return openings max2 R1/R2 with kind,claim,delta,prediction,probe,fit,assumptions,source_refs; assessment and lineage. Fit preserves/uncertain/conditional/violates; unknown indispensable resources=uncertain. Include rival, differing observation, defeat and capacity caveats. Empty openings need precise reason. Every prior ID is artifact-qualified job_id:local_id, appears once in lineage with disposition retained/changed/merged/parked/rejected, reason and current target_ids. Retained/changed one target; merged nonempty; parked/rejected none. Final reports path/hash; terminal join independently observed.
ordinary: Analyze or refine an outcome-directed operation or decision-relevant question under supplied evidence and constraints.
generic: Seek a different useful operation or discriminating test through creative exploration under supplied evidence and constraints.
necessity: Remove a hypothesized necessary action/dependency while preserving outcome; construct counterexample or explicit no viable removal. Compare removal with ordinary action; converse/inverse do not follow; include defeat.
construction: Attack max2 prior dependencies; link each to replacement/removal/test or explicit no_branch. Return attacks A1/A2 with dependency,source_refs,linked_opening_ids,disposition; linked targets must exist.
conversion: Turn supplied disturbance into an informative signal/action; specify input,path,response,rival,false/cancelling signals and defeat. Preserve outcome and resources.
interface: Use supplied known parent functions; change their interface while preserving parents. Compare parents alone, intact and broken link by opposed predictions; include setup/maintenance burden.
incumbent: Produce exactly one ordinary incumbent R1 or explicit no viable incumbent.
beneficiary: Independently identify beneficiary outcome uncertainty, feared failure and decision-changing observation.
operations: Independently identify resource, responsibility, maintenance, timing and capacity uncertainty; propose informative bounded check.
evidence: Independently identify source validity, confounds, rival predictions and defeat; mismatch alone is not causation.
consensus: Seek immediate consensus on next check from exact sources. Preserve caveats and unresolved contradictions; votes are not evidence.
deferred: Preserve opposed predictions and decision-changing uncertainty before selecting smallest separating probe; unresolved/no probe is valid.
convergence_extra: Both convergence roles return contradictions pairs of qualified prior prediction IDs, explicit incompatibility evidence, contradiction_count=len(unique pairs). Preserve every source disposition.
D_common: Read case and assigned current raw only; soft350 words, first JSON, zero retries. Return case_id,job_id,role,openings D1..D6 with source_ids,claim,discriminator,fit,probe,uncertainty; lineage and decision. Max6 D; every current raw job_id:R ID once, known unique source_ids, valid targets. Empty raw requires empty D. Optional proposals max2 P1/P2 with claim,fit,probe,uncertainty,source_gap; independently assessed, never preservation/creation credit.
ordinary_D: Reduce exact sources into a useful concise decision set; retain visible constraints/uncertainty; invent no mechanism, observation or certainty.
source_D: Protect relation, complete rivals/predictions/challenges/defeat, uncertainty, resources/capacity and declared fit. Mark inherited conflict separately. Carry parked/rejected protected content in reason or explicitly acknowledge losses; do not strengthen source meaning.
